items.title_zh: 巴基斯坦强盗持枪闯入，女孩给他棒棒糖后两手空空离开。互联网称之为“Scr”
items.title_en: Pakistan Robber Enters With Gun, Leaves Empty Handed After Girl Offers Him Lollipop. Internet Calls It ‘Scr
items.summary_zh: 当一名男子拿着枪索要钱时，一名店主和他的小女儿坐在一起，但接下来发生的事情让所有人都惊呆了。
items.summary_en: A shopkeeper is seen sitting with his young daughter when a man points a gun and demands money, but what happens next leaves everyone stunned.
